statewise_t_minus_d_definition.status: Rust-native composition of the admitted kernels; registered here so that it is scored per state against the reference function it composes
statewise_t_minus_d_definition.inputs: a design point (area_m2 A, L_over_d, phi, scenario) of the F1 design space and the 196 required states of design-state set v2 (file order)
statewise_t_minus_d_definition.per_state: D_intake(state) = A * drag_table[(scenario, L/d, phi, state)].D/A (registered order of operations); intake_drag record = {'value': D_intake, 'evidence_class': 'model-derived', 'source': 'F1 intake-face drag (drag_table) scenario <scenario> L/d <L:g> phi <phi:g> A <A:g> m^2 state <state_id>', 'parametric': True}; objective = thrust_minus_drag(None, None, thrust=None, spacecraft_drag=None, intake_drag=record) with the governed Hall status
statewise_t_minus_d_definition.thrust_rule: no thrust record is ever constructed by the composition: thrust exists only from an ADMITTED Hall member plus a design-specific Hall map, or from a measured H-1 thrust record; neither exists, so T is NOT_EVALUATED at every state (Rust-only reason key CREDIBLE_HALL_TRANSPORT_SET_EMPTY while the governed ensemble has no member; HALL_MAP_NOT_REGISTERED if a member is ever admitted before a design-specific map is registered)
statewise_t_minus_d_definition.body_drag_rule: D_body (host-spacecraft drag) is NOT_EVALUATED at every state (Rust-only reason key HOST_SPACECRAFT_DRAG_ICD_ABSENT; F1-ID-08 / S6.18); the REFERENCE/PARAMETRIC spacecraft drag never closes it
statewise_t_minus_d_definition.intake_drag_status: the F1 intake-face drag is a value with status PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY_ONLY (reference vocabulary), mapped to EvalStatus INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (SC-WP-04 gate 'intake drag surface scenario TBD'; the surface scenario is a TBD context axis)
statewise_t_minus_d_definition.no_assessment: the record carries T, D_intake, D_body and T - D with their statuses; it compares nothing with zero or with a requirement (HC-08 is SC-WP-11)
statewise_t_minus_d_definition.scored_against: the reference thrust_minus_drag with the same intake_drag record, state by state (observable statewise_t_minus_d); the Rust-only fields (EvalStatus mapping, reason keys) are asserted by cargo tests, not scored

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable of every vector meets its tolerance class; every outcome / error class / message equals the reference outcome (or the registered DIV-D-01 outcome)
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED iff every per-test, invariant, domain/error and schema check passes and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; PARITY_PASS <=> ADMITTED, PARITY_FAIL <=> NOT_ADMITTED
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust becomes authoritative for this kernel (within the registered domain); new production results for it come from Rust; the Python functions may then be retired from active execution, the module only when all its functions are admitted (RM-R17). It is NOT physics validation: the F1 intake drag stays PARAMETRIC (surface scenario TBD), T and T - D stay NOT_EVALUATED (credible Hall set EMPTY, host drag ICD absent).
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays; no execution is discarded
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, fixture or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: observables are restricted to retained selected-architecture code; no excluded legacy path (RM-R20)
decision_rules.scoring_once: the scoring comparison runs once (scoring_master_seed); the harness refuses a second scoring run when parity_report_v1.json exists
